title: Not as good as used to be
author: Mollywobbles
review_text: I purchased this jacket years ago and I loved it - until it got stolen. I got a new one but it quality isn't near as good as the old one. Thinner fabric, and different, more plasticy feel. The fit is still great, but I wish I could have my old one back. A bit pricy for what it is.

title: Advise to check size carefully - no exchange
author: Julia Gallop
review_text: Disappointing as we have been unable to exchange or return jacket which is too large

title: Too loose and too long - unflattering
author: Tina_____
review_text: Too loose and too long - vanity sizing. I bought SZ 6 (AU10) and it's loose and baggy - not figure hugging nor flattering. Disappointed considering the price.

title: Poor material
author: Poppppy
review_text: Pilling after wear for 3 times only

title: Color
author: Vvvvvvhyuij
review_text: Warm ash grey and Mauve Grey is not like they show. I'm really disappointed. Not worth it. Waste of money

title: Poor quality!!!!! Holes on my define jacket!!
author: Michyyyyyyy
review_text: I brought this a few months ago and really disappointed with the quality of this jacket, considering the price is pretty high!! I only used for several times, not even five times!! The clothes started to peel and the thread started to pull off and make small holes.

title: Define jacket brown
author: Kiendra lm
review_text: Ordered a size 6 but this time round it's too loose fitted. The black and oak sheer ones that I have are both size 6 and fit perfectly but this is loose.

title: The worst peeling
author: Abby000000
review_text: Only had this jacket for a few months and it started peeling, not good enough for how expensive it is

title: Poor quality control
author: Annie Marie
review_text: The second faulty jacket received! The actually shape and fit is very flattering but such poor quality it should have never left the warehouse!

title: Not worth the price subpar quality!
author: Jaythebell
review_text: Extremely disappointed with this bestseller! I purchased it just last week and was excited to wear it. However, after only one use, I noticed the threads starting to come loose when I put it on for the second time. The quality is subpar, especially considering the price. Definitely not worth it.

title: Poor quality
author: Feysand772
review_text: The fabric around the wrist pulled and pilled after 30 mins of wear.

title: Zipper
author: Jessieee S
review_text: Fits nice but pocket zipper fell off almost immediately?

title: SIZE DOWN!
author: Brittany bloo
review_text: The quality of material has changed, it feels cheaper/looser. I ended up going into the shop to try on a size smaller, to make it look more snatched. I own all the define nulu jackets and have noticed they have changed the material. Make sure you go down a size when ordering this, so it fits snatched, otherwise it'll arrive and will feel loose (because of new material)

title: More colours
author: user787990
review_text: i have it in black, love it, good product but we need strawberry milkshake in australia!!

title: Size
author: Koigddbjyfv
review_text: Estimated size was too big, should've gone down one size smaller

title: Extremely poor quality
author: rosieposie
review_text: The quality is completely unacceptable. I only wore this jacket once and the thread started to pull. The high price does not match the extremely low quality of the product. I'm so dissatisfied.

title: Not suitable for curves
author: Lucy loves shih tzus
review_text: I wanted an easy throw on jacket and landed on the define. It looks like a normal jacket unzipped but as soon as I zipped up it highlighted all my rolls. I was disappointed and lulu mainly sells only oversized fit jumpers which don't suit either. I returned for a long length scuba which looks better.

title: Order cancelled
author: No Santa this year
review_text: Order cancelled - did not have adequate inventory for your items. This would have been fine if it happened immediately but it was says later and after all the Black Friday sales. I will now have a ver disappointed daughter Christmas morning.

title: Bad quality
author: Sofiaaaaaa
review_text: Too expensive for terrible fabric !!!!! Lining: 56% Polyester, 33% Coolmax Polyester, 11% Lycra Elastane Body: 81% Nylon, 19% Lycra Elastane

title: Bad quality
author: Norasssss
review_text: The clothes started to pill after being worn once.

title: Never recieved.
author: f123
review_text: I never received a confirmation email and I never received my jacket. I tried contacting your support but never received any response.

title: Average
author: _NaeNae001
review_text: I was told this jacket was one of the best & that you were getting what you were paying for (as it isn't cheap!) but it is a pretty average jacket for the price. I ordered in white but the colour is more a cream.

title: Disappointing Quality
author: cassica1010
review_text: I ordered this jacket online. When it arrived, the sleeve of the jacket had been pulled out of the clear plastic bag. I didn't think much of it and assumed it was due to shipping. Then after two wears (yes, just two), I discovered that the hem under the right armpit was ripped. Although Lulu does offer repairs in-store, it is disappointing that I even have to go through this admin after wearing it only twice. It is indeed a very flattering and practical jacket, but for its price, I expected a much higher quality product and unboxing experience.

title: Buyer Beware
author: FifiBav1971
review_text: I loved the Nulu jacket I bought in colour Bone – so comfortable and perfect for those times you need a fine layer or something to layer up. However, I was disappointed when the inside of the collar appeared blistered after the first wash. The care instructions were followed precisely, and it makes no sense for the 'blistering' to appear on one side of the collar. The rest of the inside collar has bubbled over time. I'm unsure if that results from age or further washing. The fault is hidden when the zip is up so I still wear it.

title: Good looking
author: Lili Luther
review_text: Inner Collar fabric started to bubble up after 4 months,

title: Comfy but not warm
author: Ngameliag1
review_text: Soft fabric, really comfortable and looks great but feels cold when wearing. Not fleecy so didn't expect it to be really warm, but it's not warm at all and not something you could put on when you are starting to feel chilly.

title: Good fit Poor fabric
author: ninaninaninani
review_text: The fit is perfect except the arm is too long. The bone colour gets dirty very easily and already had small areas with stains on it when I received the shipping. After just a few daily wears, the fabric gets pilled very easily, especially under the arm and wrists.

title: Couldn't even wear it
author: Kaitlynn04
review_text: Tried putting it on and it was way too small for me.

title: Black jacket better quality than blue
author: Pilates Kate
review_text: I bought the blue version 1 month ago and was loving it until I was adjusting it in Pilates this week and my finger went right through and made a hole. The blue fabric doesn't seem as good quality as the black jacket, which I've had for many months with no issues.

title: Not a big fan of the fabric
author: Catsuoma05
review_text: The jacket is a nice shape but I'm not really a fan of the fabric.

title: Love this jacket!
author: Anonymous
review_text: This is great, nice fitting light-weight jacket that I am so happy I purchased. I live in regional Qld, so we have some cool days but I wanted something that I could wear walking on cold days and not get too hot, and to wear before gym classes start. V happy with this purchase!

title: Define Jacket Nulu Rocks!
author: Aunty Craw
review_text: The Define Jacket Nulu has a slimming cut and feels so soft. It's very versatile for either physical activity or casual wear. Colours are super too. I have few!

title: Fabric pills easily
author: keiko____t
review_text: I have had this jacket in 2 colours and the fabric pills so bad. Other Lululemon long sleeves I have are okay but this one is so bad for it. For $140 it's really disappointing.

title: Define Jacket Black Disappointing
author: Danielle Hy
review_text: The quality in this black define fabric is thin and nowhere near as good as it use to be 3 years ago, the colour is not a true pure black would not buy again, also did not include a Lululemon bag as they use to 3 years ago

title: Xmas
author: Anonymous
review_text: Can't actually do a review as it is hiding in my stash spot to wrap as a Xmas present for my daughter. SHE WILL LLLOOOOVVVEEEE IT THOUGH

title: Disappointed with the pulling in fabric
author: Tina linnane
review_text: I brought this a few months agi pulled it out to wear over winter and washed it a 3 times seperately from other clothes as fabric is soft unfortunately the fabric has pulled and also stitching has come undone in places too

title: Flattering Style but too Fitting
author: LululemonFan
review_text: Gorgeous colour but jacket style not for me - super flattering but too fitting even with going up a size - would love the same cut but with a looser fit.

title: New body and sleeve length?
author: SamT
review_text: So excited that I snagged the last one in Magenta Purple. I ordered my usual size 6. It is longer in body and sleeves length by an inch compared to my other Define (also size 6). It looks strangely long and ill fitting. Was there a design change? Admittedly, my other Define was like from 3 years ago. This will have to go back. Could Lulu make Define Asian Fit? :)

title: Nulu jacket
author: Zsalea Mair
review_text: Love the jacket but was confused when my order was delivered to a different house.

title: Size
author: Natalie ee
review_text: Sizing runs a bit to big :( But quality is good :)
